question: Which of the following is the first of eight Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Crafts (ASW SWCs) delivered to the Indian Navy on 8 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arnala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arnala** is the first of the eight **Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Crafts (ASW SWCs)** delivered to the **Indian Navy** on **8 May 2025**.
 
• The **ASW SWCs** are specifically designed for **anti-submarine warfare** operations in shallow waters, ensuring the protection of India's coastal regions and strategic assets.
 
• The construction of the **ASW SWCs** is part of India's initiative to strengthen its maritime security and enhance its naval capabilities. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• **Arnala** and its sister crafts are equipped with modern technologies, including **advanced sonar systems** and **torpedo launchers**, to detect and neutralize enemy submarines effectively.
 
• The project to build these crafts aligns with the **‘Make in India’ initiative**, utilizing indigenous resources and expertise for the development of defense infrastructure. *Hence, this is a significant milestone for India's defense sector.*
 
• **Arnala** is named after a coastal town in **Maharashtra**, reflecting India's tradition of naming naval vessels after places of historical and cultural importance.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Arnala.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Crafts (ASW SWCs):**

 
 
• **ASW SWCs** are designed to operate in shallow waters to detect and counter enemy submarines, ensuring coastal security.
 
• These crafts are equipped with **state-of-the-art sonar systems**, **torpedo launchers**, and **radar systems** to effectively engage underwater threats.
 
 
 
• **Indian Navy Modernization:**
 
 
• The Indian Navy has been actively modernizing its fleet to address emerging maritime security challenges.
 
• The induction of **ASW SWCs** like **Arnala** is part of India's broader strategy to enhance its naval capabilities.
 
• **Example:** Other vessels like **Kamorta-class corvettes** and **Scorpene-class submarines** have been added to the fleet to bolster maritime defense.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Indigenous Projects:**
 
 
• The construction of **ASW SWCs** under the **‘Make in India’ initiative** promotes self-reliance in defense manufacturing.
 
• It also enhances India's industrial capabilities and reduces dependence on foreign imports.
 
• This initiative strengthens India's defense infrastructure while contributing to the economy through job creation and technological advancements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Arnala-Class Vessels:**

 
 
• **Arnala-class vessels** are smaller than conventional frigates and destroyers but are specifically tailored for **shallow water operations**.
 
• They play a crucial role in protecting India's coastal regions, ports, and naval assets.
 
 
 
• **Other Examples of ASW Vessels:**
 
 
• **Kamorta-Class Corvettes:** These are larger and are designed for deeper water ASW operations, complementing the role of shallow water crafts.
 
• **Scorpene-Class Submarines:** These submarines are equipped with advanced stealth technology and are capable of engaging enemy vessels effectively.
